notes.title: Token on every request
notes.text: The relay keeps nothing; the daemon still checks the access token on each forwarded request. --no-relay keeps traffic on the local network.

notes.title: Works without the daemon
notes.text: MCP finds the daemon via runtime/daemon.json port+token; if it is down it reads and writes .vibeprint/ directly and the canvas picks it up later.

notes.title: Approval gate
notes.text: The agent rule says to propose structural changes as marks and wait for approval; MCP reports 'Waiting for the user…' progress in daemon mode.
